name: Willi's Pilsstüble
kurzbeschreibung: Willis Bar & Restaurant (formerly Willi's Pilsstüble) in Stuben am Arlberg – down-to-earth cuisine and a pub to round off a day of skiing or hiking.
beschreibung:
Willis Bar & Restaurant in Stuben am Arlberg is the current address of the former Willi's Pilsstüble in the centre of the mountain village. After a day's skiing on the Arlberg, Willi Mathies and his team invite you to the pub for „Uf a Bier beim Willi" and spoil gourmets in the restaurant with down-to-earth cuisine. Those who book ahead have a good chance of a good table; the current opening hours can be found on Google.

Stuben am Arlberg lies at around 1407 metres at the end of the Klostertal valley and is the smallest village in the Arlberg region. The establishment is located at Stuben 13b, 6762 Stuben am Arlberg. Reservations can be made directly with the team.
